payload.content: Chris uses "use default" as a shortcut for: defer to existing brand / project / infra conventions rather than re-asking. When given the choice between a custom palette and the MadeAt2AM brand kit (Warm Cream #FDFBF7, Obsidian #111111, Crimson #D32F2F, Yellow #FFC107), "use default" means use the brand kit. Same logic for subdomain casing (use lowercase), HTTP methods, libraries (prefer what's already in /root/projects/* over new ones).
